title: Not Bad
text: Not Bad. A nice chair that was pretty easy to put together. Works fine and is pretty comfortable as well. I have had worse chairs but honestly, it works great for a short time.

product_metadata.title: VigorPow Armless Mesh Office Chair Ergonomic Swivel Black Small Computer Desk Chair No Arms with Lumbar Support Height Adjustable Task Chair for Adults and Kids
features: 360° Swivel and Height Adjustable Office Chair – 360° swivel mesh seat cushion and wheels. Office chair overall height: 33.1''-37.8''(84-96cm). Chair seat height from floor: 17''-21.7''(43-55cm). Adjustable height range: about 4.7'' (12cm).

Ergonomic Mesh Office Chair – This office chair built with human-oriented design. C- shaped backrest fits the curve of your spine, upgraded Y-shaped lumbar support provide you with enough support, diminish unnecessary pressure on spine and reduce back pain.
Comfortable Armless Office Chair – No arms, no limits, suitable for kids and friendly to adults. You can slide the chair under your desk when not in use, flexible and space-saving.

High Quality Mesh Office Chair – High density mesh, soft mesh cloth, thick foam cushion, durable chair base and casters, sturdy gas lift cylinder, all components are in good quality and come from reliable suppliers.
Easy to Assemble – All components and tools included in the package, along with the installation instruction. You can usually assemble this office chair alone within 15 minutes.
